description_en: Queries product information by IDs for online calls to the Taobao Alliance edition
description_zh: 本文为您介绍GetProductInfoByIds接口的语法及示例，用于向淘宝联盟版在线调用
name: GetProductInfoByIds

parameters.help_en: The product ID string. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 40 IDs
parameters.name: item_ids

parameters.help_en:
The PID. For more information, see PID (https://mos.m.taobao.com/union/pub/site/help?spm=a219t.11817172.PortalLayout.d52e56935.27ac6a15wlAEHe).
This field is available if you use SDK V1.1.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
PID。具体请参考PID (https://mos.m.taobao.com/union/pub/site/help?spm=a219t.11817172.PortalLayout.d52e56935.27ac6a15wlAEHe)。
使用V1.1.0及以上版本的SDK可用该字段
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en: The list of fields to return. Separate multiple fields with commas (,). By default, the PicUrl, ReservePrice, Title, Url, and ZkFinalPrice fields are always returned
parameters.help_zh: 需要返回的字段list。不同的字段用逗号分割。默认PicUrl,ReservePrice,Title,Url,ZkFinalPrice字段必返回
parameters.name: fields

Code.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:
0: The request is successful.
Non-zero: The request failed
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

0：成功，
非0：失败

RankScore.description_en: The ranking score for product similarity. Valid values: 0 to 1
RankScore.description_zh: 商品相似性的排名分数。取值范围：0~1

CategoryName.description_en: The level-1 category name in the product information
CategoryName.description_zh: 商品信息-一级类目名称

CommissionRate.description_en: The commission rate in the product information. Example: 1550 indicates 15.5%
CommissionRate.description_zh:
商品信息-佣金比率。
如：1550表示15.5%

CouponAmount.description_en: The coupon amount. Unit: yuan. For presale products, this coupon can be used when paying the final balance, but cannot be used when paying the deposit
CouponAmount.description_zh: 优惠券（元），若属于预售商品，该优惠券付尾款可用，付定金不可用

CouponEndTime.description_en: The end time of the coupon in the coupon information
CouponEndTime.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券结束时间

CouponInfo.description_en: The discount information of the coupon in the coupon information
CouponInfo.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券满减信息

CouponRemainCount.description_en: The number of remaining coupons in the coupon information
CouponRemainCount.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券剩余量

CouponShareUrl.description_en: The URL of the combined product and coupon page in the link information
CouponShareUrl.description_zh: 链接-宝贝+券二合一页面链接

CouponStartFee.description_en: The threshold for using the coupon in the coupon information. The coupon can be used when the order amount reaches X yuan. Example: 20 yuan off for orders over 299 yuan
CouponStartFee.description_zh:
优惠券信息-优惠券启用门槛，满X元可用。
如：满299元减20元

CouponStartTime.description_en: The start time of the coupon in the coupon information
CouponStartTime.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券开始时间

CouponTotalCount.description_en: The total number of coupons in the coupon information
CouponTotalCount.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券总量

DeeplinkCouponShareUrl.description_en: The Taobao app wake-up link for the coupon

DeeplinkUrl.description_en: The deep wake-up link for product promotion in the link information
DeeplinkUrl.description_zh: 链接-宝贝推广的深度唤醒链接

InputItemId.description_en:
The product ID in the product information.
This field is used in SDK V1.2.3 and is the same as the ItemIds parameter passed in the search request
InputItemId.description_zh:
商品信息-商品ID。
SDK1.2.3使用，和搜索传入的ItemIds相同

ItemId.description_en:
The product ID in the product information.
This field is used in SDK V1.2.3 and represents the dynamic product ID
ItemId.description_zh:
商品信息-商品ID。
SDK1.2.3使用，动态商品ID

LevelOneCategoryName.description_en: The leaf category name in the product information
LevelOneCategoryName.description_zh: 商品信息-叶子类目名称

MaxCommission.description_en: The high commission information in the product information

MaxCommissionClickUrl.description_en: The product promotion URL with the optimal commission rate in the product information
MaxCommissionClickUrl.description_zh: 商品信息-链接-最优佣金率宝贝推广链接

MaxCommissionCouponShareUrl.description_en: The URL of the combined product and coupon page with the optimal commission rate in the product information
MaxCommissionCouponShareUrl.description_zh: 商品信息-链接-最优佣金率宝贝+券二合一页面链接

MaxCommissionRate.description_en: The optimal commission rate in the product information. Example: 20.4 indicates a commission rate of 20.4%
MaxCommissionRate.description_zh: 商品信息-最优佣金率。 如：20.4表示佣金率为20.4%

Nick.description_en: The seller nickname in the store information

PicUrl.description_en: The main product image URL in the product information

PriceAfterCoupon.description_en: The price after coupon deduction in the product information

Provcity.description_en: The location of the product in the product information

ReservePrice.description_en: The reserve price in the product information. This is the fixed price and is usually displayed as a strikethrough price
ReservePrice.description_zh: 商品信息-一口价通常显示为划线价

SellerId.description_en: The seller ID in the store information

ShopTitle.description_en: The store name in the store information

ShortTitle.description_en: The short product title in the product information. Use this title on mobile clients
ShortTitle.description_zh: 商品信息-商品短标题（移动端建议使用）

SubTitle.description_en: The product subtitle in the product information

Title.description_en: The product title in the product information

Url.description_en: The product promotion URL in the link information

UserType.description_en:
The seller type in the store information. Valid values:
1: Tmall
0: Taobao
UserType.description_zh:
店铺信息-卖家类型。

1：天猫，
0：淘宝

Volume.description_en: The 30-day sales volume in the product information

ZkFinalPrice.description_en: The online selling price in the product information. Unit: yuan. For presale products, the online selling price equals the presale price during the deposit payment period
ZkFinalPrice.description_zh: 商品信息-在线售价(元)。若属于预售商品，付定金时间内，在线售卖价=预售价格

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
